summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from RIT (May 2026) specializing in robotics software and edge AI. Built and deployed a vision-guided pick-and-place arm using TensorRT YOLO on Jetson at 18 FPS with 100% pick reliability. Proficient in ROS2, C++, Python, computer vision, and hardware-software integration across capstone, competition, and internship work.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Led 25-member robotics team across national competitions owning mechanical design, PCB fabrication, and AI/ML integration; ranked 10th nationally at Robocon (45 universities).
Designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Deployed ZoeDepth monocular depth estimation for crack-depth profiling with ±8% error on 3D surface reconstruction in a live industrial inspection pipeline.
Architected a full metal surface inspection system combining custom image stitching, wavelet denoising, and depth estimation for microscopic crack analysis.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi Pico and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Curated a custom YOLOv8 detection dataset; improved classification accuracy from 78% to 97.5% and deployed model in a consumer mobile app.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end voice-to-picked latency; resolved 11 hardware-software integration failures including false-positive detections, servo crosstalk, and rolling-shutter stereo depth.
Integrated TensorRT YOLO visual servoing at ~18 FPS, dual VL53L0X ToF sensors for contact-aware grasping, and implemented two-link IK on Arduino in C++.

projects.name: ROS-Based Robotic Arm (AL5B & UR5e)
bullets: Executed collision-free pick-and-place on a physical UR5e via UR ROS 2 driver; AL5B repeatability <2mm over 10 trials.
Derived full FK chains (0T6) for 6-DoF UR5e and 5-DoF AL5B; validated against MoveIt and RViz URDF models in ROS 2 Humble and ROS Noetic.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Deployed YOLOv8 on Jetson for real-time tracking; commanded STM32 over UART with FreeRTOS mutex-protected shared state, interrupt-driven UART, and VL53L0X ToF sensing.

projects.name: ABB RobotStudio Automation Simulation
bullets: Simulated ABB RobotStudio workcell for press-to-packing assembly; programmed in RAPID with TCP socket pose acquisition and interrupt-driven press-bench logic.
